svg.title: Anatomy of one turn
svg.desc: Four layers run in order inside a single API request: the Intent Router assigns a lane without calling a provider, the Director runs every turn, the Performer writes one turn of prose and proposes events, and validation plus commit turn accepted claims into an append-only event and a checkpoint.

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, PingFang SC, sans-serif
-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, PingFang SC, sans-serif

svg.text: The Performer proposes. Only a validated claim becomes an immutable event.

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, PingFang SC, sans-serif
-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, PingFang SC, sans-serif

g.text: Pure function. Assigns a lane. Never calls a provider.

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, PingFang SC, sans-serif
-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, PingFang SC, sans-serif

g.text: Runs every turn. Lanes 1 and 2 record intent; lanes 3 and 4 plan and gate on approval.

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, PingFang SC, sans-serif
-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, PingFang SC, sans-serif

g.text: Writes one turn of prose. Proposes events; it never commits them.

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, PingFang SC, sans-serif
-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, PingFang SC, sans-serif

g.text: Participation, agency, off-stage and off-screen checks, then commit.

svg.text: A rejected turn is recorded as rejected. No event is committed from a failed turn.
